reviews.review: I wish the game wasn't so hard on the newcomers. I would be completely lost if it wasn't for a friend who helped me with a ton of things. The start feels pretty slow, not to mention I got boosted. However, if you keep playing, you will love it. And some of the quests are just amazing. Shame they're kinda hidden and scattered. But when in doubt, always check the Warframe Wiki.

In progress review:

This is the first time I'm doing a review like this but I think it's usefull for newer players and for myself to see how feelings may or may not change towards the game as experience and knowledge come in play.

30 hour mark - I just finished my first half day run on this game and I must say it was pretty amazing! Wondering if my Soma Prime BP is actually so rare. Would definately recommend this game at this stage.

50 hour mark - Turns out my blueprint for Soma Prime isn't rare. Found a couple of friendly OP players in a defense mission on Jupiter. One thing led to another and I found out what Taxi means. They helped me unlock 3 planets. Feeling pretty good. Also the first time I need Platinum ( Ingame currency) for weapon slots. I guess microtransactions is needed Im not arguing. Im starting to understanding that using the right mods is very important in this game.

100 hour mark - First of all. I rarely get more than 100 hours on any game. At this point of the game I have found myself a clan with a lot of rare and usefull blueprints which I can just buy. Right now I am Mastery Rank 6. I have finished all the planets bosses and have farmed 6 warframes which is finished and ready to play with. One of these includes Saryn which alone took about 7-10 hours. I have all the planets except 1. The last one. Eris. The boss that unlocks Eris is an Archwing mission and to be honest I do not want to even try to complete it. The farming that is needed is tremendous. After I complete the last boss and have all the planets. Whats left? Will this game become a farming simulator?
This game is amazing, great community and constant updates.

This game is overall pretty good. Its free to play, which at least allows me to reccomend anyone to try it out, and pretty much everything can be acquired without spending actual money. While yes, the actual spending part is the more desired route, as its a hell of a lot easier than grinding through to get everything, the grinding through and the success you feel after gathering everything is also pretty great. One thing I did have a problem with, however, is the wait times for the items after you get all the parts. Its not too much of a big deal, but its slightly annoying. Another thing I have to say: This will be one of those games where you will binge play it a ton and then stop playing for a long time, only to go back to it later. Thats not to say that the game is bad, its really fun. Its just that at some point you may grow a bit bored of the game. It can get repetitive.

tl;dr
PROS
- Pretty damn fun and addictive
- Free (and not pay-to-win)
- Different frames, with different skills, are pretty fun as well.
- Gathering everything and gaining something you wanted is satisfying.

CONS
- Wait times after you gather the parts. Not too big of a deal.
- Can get boring after a while.
One of the best Games ive ever played.
